description: Delete a hosted-loop (or organisation-level) secret by name. Pass loop (the hosted Claude loop's id, from /connect/claude/deploy) for the loop's own secret — its owner only — or org (organisation slug, admin-scoped token) for an organisation-level secret every loop of the organisation inherits; a loop-level name overrides the organisation's. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is the loop's model key (CAP-S.8: the platform never lends its own); at organisation level it is the BYOK override. A secret that does not exist is a not-found error, never reported as deleted. Audit-logged. Returns {name, deleted: true}.

name.description: Secret name, an environment variable name: letters, digits and _, starting with a letter (stored upper-case). PATH, HOME, INPUT and GLUECRON_* are the runtime's own and refused.

name: merjax_delete_loop_secret
